why.D-L4-1c: registered as L-unseen-lender caught by code_rank. In v2.2 unseen lenders take the top codes within each type's leading digit; a rank feature alone doesn't express that, and the per-family tree reads one family at a time. The label leaked through code_shape and code_name_links instead
why.D-L4-1d: registered as L-no-card-cue caught by code_name_links. Cued and uncued cards share the issuer's code in v2.2, so a card-word name elsewhere on the code marks a card, not a card without a cue: the channel acts on T-card-repayment, not L-no-card-cue

channels_replaced.finding: reserved unseen lenders take the top codes
channels_replaced.rule: caught when L-unseen-lender leaks through any structure family
